tldr: Sun in the 11th house routes identity and life force through community and future vision.
body: With the Sun in the 11th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through friendship, community, networks, hopes, audiences, and the future. This makes how you belong, collaborate, and give your gifts to something larger than yourself a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through community and future vision.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in community and future vision.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
